The vice president of payer strategy & managed care operations oversees all aspects of payer contracting and relations with responsibility for the strategy, negotiation and execution of fee-for-service and value-based contracts for Northern Light Health (NLH) and all its subsidiary member organizations. The vice president is similarly responsible for aligning both the tactical (near-term) and the strategic (long-term) objectives of NLH in each contract. Outpatient Internal Medicine Physician – Bangor, Maine

Northern Light Eastern Maine Medical Center is seeking a dedicated outpatient Internal Medicine Physician to join our busy, well-established, and quality-driven primary care practice in Bangor, Maine. Be part of our team that values collaboration, clinical excellence, and a shared commitment to improving the health and well-being of our community.

• Provide comprehensive, patient-centered care in a modern facility

• Supportive, collegial, and professional environment
